items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: He was a man by the name of Teet. I don't know if you remember that.

ctx.x: Well, that was the first band that was over there. I know it was a long time ago. And, uh... It was... I don't know who the hell was the leader of it. I think it was Ellis Straticus. I'm not sure. But then later, I found a name of... Johnny, uh... He was a sales manager for CG Khan. He said, well, we went up to Jackson, Mississippi. Slim Lamar. Slim Lamar was his name. He was a sales manager for the head of the Khan agency down here. He was a man by the name of Teet. I don't know if you remember that.
No. No, I don't know that.
